story.text: Mrs. Bennet is happy at last, with two daughters so well married. Mr. Bennet {MISSES} Lizzy, and loves to turn up at {PEMBERLEY} when least expected. Kitty, kept away from Lydia, grows far less silly. Mary stays at home with her {BOOKS}. Lydia writes only to ask for {MONEY}, for the Wickhams never stop {SPENDING}. Even Lady Catherine, after long {SULKING}, comes to visit.
story.caption: Seeing them off
